Name: Krikos Peninsula - Greenhouse and PIF
Author: mushymato
Description:
[size=5]Features[/size]
[list]
[*]There's 7 squares of 48 tillable dirt, plus a number of side planters for bushes and fruit trees. The sand is also tilable.
[*]The side planters can fit a total of 26 fruit trees. To achieve this some wooden tiles are marked as "able to hold fruit tree". See screenshots for the arrangement. Fruit trees planted here take on seasonal appearances but still bear fruit all year around (need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423]Misc Map Actions & Properties[/url]).
[*]Can construct buildings, both carpenter shop and wizard (need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423]Misc Map Actions & Properties[/url])
[*]The waters have ocean fish, though there is more trash here than the beach. Can place crab pots too.
[*]At night, the main planting area and the decorative background trees + foliage lights up.
[/list]
[size=4]CP Only:[/size][list]
[*]Besides following the game's normal seasons, a season override can be specified in the config.
[/list]
[size=4]PIF Only:[/size]
[list]
[*]The PIF room is not marked as a greenhouse by default, it must be enabled in config.
[/list]
[size=4]Installation:[/size]
[list]
[*]The CP greenhouse replacer and the PIF room are independent, you can install either or both.
[/list]
[size=4]Translations:[/size]
[list]
[*]English
[*]Simplified Chinese
[/list]
